root_cause_label: Premature Task Completion Without Any Information Retrieval
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent performed only irrelevant local filesystem exploration and then created an empty result file without ever attempting to retrieve or compute the top Scandinavian MTEB leaderboard model.
t_err_evidence: Step 1 runs 'find /app -type f -name "*.txt"' — a local filesystem search wholly irrelevant to looking up the MTEB leaderboard; the agent has already chosen the wrong strategy on the very first action.
t_commit_evidence: With only 3 steps total and the first action being an irrelevant local search, the failure is locked in at step 1 since the agent never pivots to any form of external leaderboard lookup.
t_surface_evidence: Step 3 creates /app/result.txt as an empty file (no model name written), which is the first observable signal that no answer was produced.
trigger_explanation: The task requires looking up the MTEB leaderboard (an external resource) to find the top Scandinavian embedding model. The agent never reads the task specification carefully enough to recognize this external-lookup requirement; instead it searches the local /app directory as if the answer could be found there.
